editorial:
Imagine moving your whole life to the quiet countryside for a fresh start, only to find out your neighbor is a total nightmare. You follow a family that looks perfect on the outside, but as soon as they settle into their new rural home, things get weird. The vibe starts out peaceful and sunny, but it quickly turns into a game of cat and mouse. You can really feel the tension build up as the neighbor starts crossing lines, making you wonder if the family is actually safe or if they just walked into a trap. It is the kind of movie that makes you want to double-check your locks before going to bed.

The acting is top-notch, especially the guy playing the creepy neighbor who manages to be scary without even saying much. The plot moves quickly, though a few parts in the middle drag a bit. If you love movies that keep you guessing, you will love the big twists at the end. You should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the detail in the woods, or just rent it on Apple TV for a movie night. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is a great move.
endingExplained: You find out that the neighbor was not just crazy, but was actually hunting the family for a twisted game. In the final scene, the parents fight back in a brutal struggle in the basement. The twist is that the neighbor had a whole network of people helping him. The movie ends with the family escaping, but as they drive away, you see a photo of them on a wall in another house, meaning they are still being watched.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves home invasion stories and creepy neighbors.
